ÇALIŞKAN DÜKKAN — iOS 1.0.4 TESTFLIGHT RELEASE
Date: 2026-11-09
User requested product photos from Çalışkan Dükkan web administration to render in the native iOS inventory list.
Root cause: PostgreSQL BIGINT store IDs from the authorized stores endpoint can be strings; the existing mobile image resolver rejected string store IDs before constructing an image source.
Changes: coerce and strictly validate store IDs (string/number) for store-scoped thumbnail URLs; preserve bearer Authorization only on matching admin.ecalisgan.com private endpoints; add unit regression tests.
Verified before release: product-image resolver tests succeeded, native TypeScript check succeeded, admin branding check succeeded, Expo iOS JS export succeeded.
Native package / Expo app version: 1.0.4
Expo project: 21b3de7c-763f-4c25-87aa-66e818498d6e
iOS bundle: com.caliskan.dukkan
App Store Connect app: 6826848065
Release request automatically runs validation, EAS IPA build, and App Store Connect TestFlight submission.
No data migration; no warehouse stock mutations; no B2B or Business app changes.
